redistribution_obligations: Retain fixed article URLs, complete linked histories, contributor attribution and separately credited original-work layers.

external_factual_corroboration.author_interpretation: The French public attraction description uses G for the acceleration experienced by ordinary ride passengers. Together with the fixed Wiktionnaire French masculine invariable noun and IPA, this supports a modern recreational reading of the acceleration unit. Physics register is retained; everyday eligibility remains for independent review. Uppercase G in public display is usage corroboration only and adds no alias for the exact frozen lowercase g group.

external_factual_corroboration.author_interpretation: OQLF identifies centimètre as n. m. and lists cm with its symbol-writing rules. Wiktionnaire supplies the exact French cm pronunciation and the centimètre noun definition explicitly identifying cm as its symbol. The proposal retains the frozen cm/NOM membership while exposing the source symbol classification; it does not claim that cm is an independently attested lexical noun or that NOM is the source symbol label. The symbol has no plural ending or abbreviation point; centimètre is its nominal spoken reading. Independent construction/classification review remains pending.
